name: TermSquad
description: TermSquad lets agents start and prompt remote coding agents, read their output, run squads, and manage scheduled tasks on always-on computers. Each user signs in through the browser and chooses which computers, workspaces, and permissions to grant.

prompts.text: List my TermSquad computers and their workspaces.
Check the status of my coding agents and summarize their latest output.
Start a coding agent to review the latest changes in my selected workspace.

apps.name: TermSquad
apps.description: Remote agent sessions, squads, scheduled tasks, and workspace access, over TermSquad's MCP server with browser sign-in.
